Cave Guiding & Mentoring · Fort White, Florida

Guided cave dives in North Florida.

Already cave certified and visiting North Florida's Cave Country? From my base in Fort White, I guide certified cave divers through the North Florida springs, including Ginnie Springs, Little River, Peacock Springs, Cow Springs, Madison Blue Spring and many other systems, as well as the cenotes of the Riviera Maya near Tulum and Playa del Carmen. I also offer one-on-one mentoring for technical divers.

Cave Guiding

  • Guided cave dives for certified cave divers, based in Fort White and tailored to your certification, configuration (backmount, sidemount or CCR) and comfort level across the North Florida spring networks, including Ginnie Springs, Little River, Peacock Springs, Cow Springs and Madison Blue Spring, plus many other systems in the region, and the cenote systems of the Riviera Maya near Tulum and Playa del Carmen, Mexico.
  • Full logistics coordination, site briefing, environmental gas planning, and international trip support. I'll do as much or as little of the work as you want. It's your dive, and I'm here to help.

Mentoring

  • One-on-one technical diving mentorship focusing on skill mastery, platform configuration tuning, and trim workshops for divers progressing across any technical configuration.
  • Personalized video review, propulsion technique adjustment, and custom gear optimization tailored to your exact anatomy.

FAQ

Cave guiding questions

For certified cave divers planning a trip to Fort White and the North Florida springs.

I'm cave certified and visiting North Florida's Cave Country. Can you guide me in the caves?

Yes. Rimstone Technical Diving is based in Fort White, Florida, in the middle of Cave Country, so it doesn't matter whether you're staying in Fort White, High Springs, Branford, Lake City or anywhere nearby. Ginnie Springs, Little River, Peacock Springs, Cow Springs and Madison Blue Spring are all a short drive away. Guided cave dives are planned around your certification level, configuration and the systems you want to see.

Who is cave guiding for?

Cave guiding is for divers who already hold a cave certification and want local knowledge of the North Florida spring systems. Every dive stays within the limits of your certification. If you are not yet certified, the Cavern, Intro to Cave and Full Cave courses are the place to start.

Which North Florida cave sites do you guide?

Guided dives take place across the North Florida spring networks, including Ginnie Springs (Devil's Eye and Devil's Ear), Little River, Peacock Springs, Cow Springs and Madison Blue Spring. There are many other systems in the region available to tour as well, so tell me what you would like to see.

Can you guide sidemount, backmount and CCR divers?

Yes. Guiding is tailored to your configuration, whether you dive backmount, sidemount or a closed-circuit rebreather.

What does a guided cave dive include?

A site briefing, dive and gas planning for the system, logistics coordination and an experienced local guide in the water with you. I'll do as much or as little of the work as you want. It's your dive, and I'm here to help.

Do you guide in Mexico too?

Yes. Cave guiding is also offered in the Riviera Maya cenotes near Tulum and Playa del Carmen, Mexico, with international trip support.

How do I book a guided cave dive?

Email tim@rimstonediving.com or call (206) 227-9715 with your certification level, configuration, dates and the sites you are interested in.
